rules.name: dt/dd must be inside dl
rules.description: WHATWG HTML: <dt> and <dd> are only valid inside a <dl> group (directly or inside a <div> wrapper).

rules.name: Bypass block: skip link to main content
rules.description: WCAG 2.2 2.4.1 (A): a mechanism must exist to bypass repeated blocks. A skip link to #main-content is the auditable mechanism; if another bypass exists it must be documented.

rules.name: Link purpose: avoid a raw URL as the only link text
rules.description: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 (A) can be satisfied by context; a raw URL is reported as a recommendation, not as a normative P1 failure.

rules.name: Semantic navigation: page should contain a <nav> landmark
rules.description: Absence of semantic navigation is distinct from a missing category link and from a <nav> without an accessible name.

rules.name: Accessible name for every <nav> landmark
rules.description: WAI-ARIA landmark best practice: when a page has one or more <nav> elements, each should have aria-label or aria-labelledby.

rules.name: Main landmark should expose id="main-content"
rules.description: <main> without an id is valid HTML; the id is a recommendation so the skip link has a stable target.

rules.name: Header/footer inside main lose their implicit landmark role
rules.description: <header> and <footer> inside <main> are valid HTML, but they no longer map to banner/contentinfo. Reported as a landmark recommendation, never as P1.

rules.name: Ficha should contain at least one valid internal link
rules.description: A ficha with only external links is a dead end for the offline atlas. This is a navigation recommendation, not an HTML error.

rules.name: Ficha must link to its category index
rules.description: The expected target is derived from catalogo.json (tool.cat -> categorias[numero].href), then resolved relative to the ficha directory.

rules.name: Ficha should link to existing technical resources
rules.description: Existing README/metadata/SHA256/GUIA/SKILL/casos/evidencias files that are not linked are reported as completeness recommendations.

rules.name: Section should have a heading or accessible name
rules.description: A <section> without a heading is valid HTML; the recommendation improves document structure and screen-reader navigation.

rules.name: Stylesheet should define :focus-visible
rules.description: WCAG 2.2 2.4.7 (AA) requires a visible focus indicator; the browser default already provides one. :focus-visible is a recommendation for the visual contract.

rules.name: ATDS badge must match the official validation report
rules.description: Reads reports/atds-validation.json (the official result). Only checks badges that are present; legacy sheets without a badge are not penalised.

rules.name: Page should have a non-empty meta description
rules.description: Publication/SEO convention; it is not an HTML conformance error and not a WCAG failure.

rules.name: Prefer shared CSS over inline style attributes
rules.description: The DOCUMENT CSP allows style-src 'unsafe-inline' for historical pages, so this is a visual-contract convention (P3), never an HTML or WCAG error.
